question: Can myriads upon myriads of cosmic ages equal the sin-destroying merit gained by feeding a cow?
premises: Feeding a cow is purifying in the world.
Feeding a cow cuts away all sins.
Myriads of hundreds of crores of kalpas do not match this merit.
inference: The sin-destroying efficacy of offering a morsel to a cow surpasses what could be accumulated over immeasurably vast spans of cosmic time.
uncertainties: The exact numerical force of the compounded time units is hyperbolic and not precisely quantifiable.
plain_english: Not even in hundreds of millions of crores of kalpas could such merit be equaled.
